profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at UKG (Ultimate Kronos Group)
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Test Automation, Data Warehousing and Continuous Integration/Deployment Development. Strong engineering professional with excellent technical, analytical and
communication skills.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: 50/50 hands-on engineer, continuing to support the SDLC via code reviews, design sessions and mentorship. 50/50 engineering leader, collaborating with engineering and product teams to provide estimates, feature prioritization/planning and representing the data team in large organization initiatives (leveraging GCP, migration to Github, addressing security vulnerabilities). Lead a team of ~15 onshore/offshore engineers that support our multi-tenant Data Warehouse products

positions.title: Tech Lead I
positions.description: Mentor engineers via code reviews, one on ones and knowledge transfers. Support the data team’s technical vision/ architecture for new and existing projects. Step in as necessary to support our SRE team with automation, deployments, production services.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Skills: Terraform

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Design, build and maintain the CI/CD infrastructure and tools to deliver Big Data, Data Warehousing Services. Work closely with development teams to ensure that solutions meet environment requirements and conform to best practices. Design and Develop the test automation to validate the builds in the CI/CD pipeline.

positions.title: Software Quality Engineer III
positions.description: Designed and developed back-end testing frameworks using C# & SQL to assist in the automation of test cases. Wrote automated Nunit integration and system tests to validate Ssis ETL packages for a Data Warehouse as well as a near real time eventing solution. Took part in regression and exploratory test sessions during feature releases. Mentored quality engineers with code and test reviews. Assisted in automating the configuration required for a Data Warehouse development/test environment. Worked closely with developers and tech leads in designing and modelling new Data Warehouse features for analytical and operational reporting.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Participated in the constant improvement of Test Automation, and Continuous Integration practices.
Wrote SQL code as part of data setup, as well as to verify test results in manual and automated testing. Produce and maintain unit, services/integration, and system tests using QA methodologies. Work proactively with members of an Agile team to find and fix defects within the product architecture.

positions.title: TechSTAR
positions.description:
Internship opportunity within an agile environment, using cutting edge tools and QA methodologies.
Received mentoring from Software Test Engineers, Software Engineers and Software Test Architects.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop Costa Farms in-house ERP software using VB.NET for front-end programming. Maintain back-end logic using T-SQL, including but not limited to creating and altering stored procedures, triggers and functions.Process user issues through Kaseya ticketing platform.

positions.title: Software/Web Development Intern
positions.description: Resolved user tickets using the Kasaya platform. Developed and maintained Costa Farms in-house ERP software using Visual Studio. Established skills building UI's using VB.NET and third-party controls such as Dev-Express for the front-end development. Developed web projects using ASP.NET, Javascript and AJAX.

positions.title: Internet Quality Assurance
positions.description: Conducted in-depth internet based research and developed a thorough understanding of online search tools and strategies.

positions.title: Search Quality Consultant
positions.description: Analyzed user Internet browsing habits and interpreted query usage in order to understand, improve, and enhance the user experience.

projects.title: IBM Master the Mainframe
projects.description: Entered the IBM Master the Mainframe contest and received valuable hands on experience with traversing and engaging a mainframe.

organizations.name: CSNP - Charlotte CyberSecurity Non Profit
organizations.description: CyberSecurity Non-Profit (CSNP) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit promoting security education and inclusivity. Our goal is to make cybersecurity knowledge and training accessible, so everyone can protect themselves and their organizations from cyber threats.
